name: auto-effort
description: Lets Jev, a System One model, pick Claude's effort level for each prompt

api_key.title: Jev API key
api_key.description: Bearer key for the Jev endpoint, such as an OpenCode Zen key. Falls back to AUTO_EFFORT_API_KEY.

endpoint.title: Jev endpoint
endpoint.description: System One endpoint URL (use https: the key is sent as a bearer token). Falls back to AUTO_EFFORT_ENDPOINT, then https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/systemone.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model sent to the endpoint, such as jev-1.13 or jev-1.13-free. Falls back to AUTO_EFFORT_MODEL, then jev-1.13.

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this Jev confidence (0 to 1) the session's own effort stands. Defaults to 0.5.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Jev before keeping the session's own effort. Defaults to 4000.

min_effort.title: Lowest effort
min_effort.description: Lowest level the mod may pick: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Defaults to low.

max_effort.title: Highest effort
max_effort.description: Highest level the mod may pick: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Defaults to xhigh.

include_context.title: Send Claude's last reply
include_context.description: Also send Claude's previous reply (truncated) to Jev so follow-ups like 'yes, do it' are classified correctly. Defaults to true.
